ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher; note the inconsistent "I'm Here" records for driver-side review.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's assertion (F13) that he was parked at the pickup and waited >3 min is contradicted by the GPS record: F3 shows the stationary position was 181 m from the pickup on a side road, and F1 shows the closest approach was 60 m — he never positioned at the pinned entrance, and the rider could not find him (F11). Under NS-2 the NS-1 elements are not reliably met, so the $6.61 fee does not stand.

The NS-2 flag_account add-on requires the driver to have pressed 'I'm Here' while GPS shows him outside the pickup range. The 181 m stationary position (F3) is inside the 200 m radius, so the fraud trigger is not established; the F6/F7 contradiction is left for human review rather than an automatic flag.
